lines.text: static void expect_offset(const char *scroll_id, int want, const char *message)

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: fprintf(stderr, "input_harness: %s offset %d, want %d\n", scroll_id, got, want);

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Scroll S 300x120 with gap 10: s0..s3 are 40 high at content y 0, 50, 100 and 150, so the offset goes up to 70.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // The Scrolls here are wider than their buttons so that the D-pad, which can focus a Scroll too, prefers the buttons.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("focus:s0 blur:s0 focus:s1", "the D-pad moves to the visible s1");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("S", 0, "a visible control keeps the offset");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:s1 focus:s2", "the D-pad moves to the partly hidden s2");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("S", 20, "the D-pad scrolls just enough to show s2's bottom edge");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:s2 focus:s3", "the D-pad reaches the fully hidden s3");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("S", 70, "the D-pad scrolls s3 into view");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("", "Down at the end of the Scroll keeps Focus");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:s3 focus:s2", "the D-pad moves back up");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("S", 70, "moving back to a visible control keeps the offset");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:s2 focus:s1 blur:s1 focus:s0", "the D-pad walks back to s0");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("S", 0, "the D-pad scrolls just enough to show s0's top edge");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:s2 focus:s0", "hovering the partly hidden s0 focuses it");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("S", 20, "hover does not scroll, so the content stays under the pointer");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Scroll T 300x80 holds t0..t3, 40 high each: t0 and t1 fill the viewport exactly and t2, t3 are fully hidden.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:t1 focus:t2", "Down from the last visible row reaches the hidden t2");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:t3 focus:t2 blur:t2 focus:t1", "Up walks back to t1");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // A column Stack holds Scroll U (150x80, u0..u3 40 high each) and, 10 below it, Button below. Hidden rows of U lie

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // over below's position, so the D-pad must prefer the nearer row and only then leave the Scroll.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:u1 focus:u2", "the hidden u2 is nearer than the Button below the Scroll");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:u2 focus:u3", "the hidden u3 is nearer too");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:u3 focus:below", "Down from the last row leaves the Scroll");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("U", 80, "leaving the Scroll keeps its offset");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:below focus:u3", "Up comes back to the nearest row");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Same Stack as test_focus_leaves_scroll, at offset 0: hidden u2 and u3 lie below Button below, so Down from

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // below must not jump to them; Up enters at the last visible row instead.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("", "Down from the Button below a Scroll does not jump to a hidden row");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("U", 0, "the Scroll does not move when Down finds nothing below");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect(input_is_focused("below"), "Focus stays on the Button below the Scroll");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:below focus:u1", "Up from below enters at the last visible row");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("U", 0, "entering at a visible row keeps the offset");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Header Button over Scroll L (300x160, r0..r9 40 high each) in a column Stack, scrolled to the bottom

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // (offset 240): r6 is the first visible row. Up from the header finds nothing; Down enters at r6 without

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("L", 240, "focusing the header keeps the list scrolled to the bottom");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("", "Up from the header above a scrolled list is a no-op");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("L", 240, "the no-op Up keeps the offset");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:header focus:r6", "Down from the header enters at the first visible row");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("L", 240, "entering at the first visible row does not shift the list");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Scroll O 100x100 flows o0 (80 high), Scroll I (60 high) and o1 (40 high), so its offset goes up to 80.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // I holds i0..i3, 40 high each, so its offset goes up to 100.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("I", 60, "the inner Scroll shows i2 first");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("O", 40, "then the outer Scroll shows where i2 ended up");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("O", 0, "the outer Scroll scrolls back for o0");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_offset("I", 60, "a Scroll that does not contain the focused control keeps its offset");

lines.text: fprintf(stderr, "input_harness: editing \"%s\", want \"%s\"\n", got ? got : "(none)", text);

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Text Input t (value "hi", at most 5 UTF-16 code units) left of Button a.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("focus:t", "hovering a Text Input focuses it");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect(!input_is_editing_text(), "a Text Input does not edit before the Press ends");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("pressstart:t pressend:t press:t", "a Text Input is pressed like a Button");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect(input_is_editing_text(), "a Press on a Text Input starts editing");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect(input_editing_text("a") == NULL, "only the edited Text Input shows editing text");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("", "editing reports nothing before it ends");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("text:t:hi!", "Enter confirms once with the edited value");

lines.author: Máté Molnár

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect(input_is_focused("t"), "the Text Input keeps Focus after the edit");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("", "the Enter that confirmed does not press again");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("pressstart:t pressend:t press:t", "the next Cross presses the Text Input again");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_editing("hi", "a new edit starts from the value the Deck App holds");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect(input_is_editing_text(), "Cross on a focused Text Input starts editing");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("", "keys after a cancel reach nothing");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("blur:t", "a runtime restart reports no value, only the blur");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect(!input_is_editing_text(), "removing the Text Input ends editing");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("", "a removed Text Input reports no value");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_editing("abc", "a value longer than maxLength is cut when editing starts");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_editing("\xf0\x9f\x98\x80", "an emoji counts as two code units, like a JS string");

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: expect_events("focus:t pressstart:t pressend:t press:t text:t:ab", "the value is confirmed once");
